extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners and petitioners seeking reinstatement before the USPTO (Office of Enrollment and Discipline)
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation and decision process for petitions to reinstate a practitioner to practice before the USPTO under the Office of Enrollment and Discipline, including required supporting affidavit(s) under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 and review of record materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Ilya Zborovsky (Registration Number 28,563) received on May 20, 2019.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petition for reinstatement must be submitted (dated/received), and the fact of receipt and petition content are material to the Office's consideration. The petition is the initiating document for reinstatement review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Zborovsky also filed an affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An affidavit filed under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is an expected supporting document for a reinstatement petition; its presence and contents are considered as part of the eligibility review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consideration of petition, affidavit, supplemental information, and other record materials
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the petition, the supporting affidavit, supplemental information provided by Mr. Zborovsky to OED during the review of the petition, and all other information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office's review is holistic: it includes the petition, any supporting affidavit(s), supplemental information provided during review, and any other record information material to eligibility. Decisions turn on the totality of these materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's determination and grant of reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement of Mr. Zborovsky to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office is appropriate. Accordingly, the petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director (Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline) has final authority to determine whether reinstatement is appropriate and to grant or deny the petition based on the review of submissions and record materials.
